policy: A registered candidate is the only artifact the publisher may offer as a real submission. Registration requires byte hash, run card, holdout evidence and uniqueness evidence; everything unregistered stays DO NOT SUBMIT.

candidates.decision_basis: format validator passes on saved bytes; 4-fold whole-fault holdout measured; rank correlation vs 93 registry rasters max 0.565 (< 0.90); no leaderboard estimate is defensible (holdout-to-leaderboard LOO R2 < 0)
